spec: docs/WP12_SPECIFICATION.md Phase 4 (4.4 orientation envelope) and Phase 5 (5.3, 5.4); the decision names this file configs/wp12/phase4_e2_envelope_confirmation_protocol_v1.json, the user instruction of 2026-10-31 names it phase4_e2_protocol_v1.json (same content)
declared: 2026-10-31 (KST). Written before any formal E2 row. Only DEV smokes ran before the commit (dev_runs_before_commit); they are never evidence. The orchestrator commits this file before the formal rows; a change afterwards is a new protocol version. Failed, crashed and budget-stopped rows are kept and reported, never rescored or silently rerun.
purpose: Envelope confirmation through the REAL pipeline. Every validated cell of supported_envelope_v1 so far came from scripted or partial runs; the Phase 5 ID may use a cell only if it is validated (decision D5). E2 runs one declared row per candidate cell through the goal planner, controller_profile path_v2, WaypointPolicy and goal_eval_v2a, and records the outcome as a proposed envelope v2 (a new version; v1 stays untouched; the xhigh reviewer decides). Two flat-board rows (theta 2 and 5 deg) are a falsification test of the decision D1 armed-end argument.
frozen_and_unchanged: tlmpm*.py and law 8 (no parameter overridden: cut_diagnostics_v1 is read-only)
goal_planner.py, policies.py (path_v2 as committed), goals.py thresholds and goal_eval_v1/v2/v2a
blade_master_flat_board_v1 and its slotted variant rule
configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v1.json (DECLARED) and every frozen record, WP-11 evidence and earlier run directory

scope: Kinematic ideal tracking (no robot dynamics, PhysX, grasp or cameras); the motion preflight is geometric (Newton IK + C2 MuJoCo distances, flat-board blade/board rule). Law 8, tlmpm_v5, ruler_knife_v2_y, 1 mm particles, 4 mm grid, material dt 0.1 ms, control dt 20 ms, seed 42, cutting_tasks_v1 (provisional, uncalibrated). One run per row: a CONFIRMED row validates one point of a cell, never a range by itself. No Native row: decision D5 runs Demos 2 and 6 in Native only after their E2 rows.

common.board_rule: Every scene is one continuous cutting board on the table (supports.kind flat_board). The board is CO-ROTATED with the workpiece (cutting_board.yaw_deg = workpiece yaw: flat_board_v1 has no oriented TLMPM fixture boxes) and its centre stays at the record value, so a yaw that turns a board corner past the table edge is scene_geometrically_infeasible. The workpiece z is the board top (flat_board_workcell.place_on_board). Slotted boards only where a family declares board_kind.

slotted_rule.text: Explicit Option D (ADR 0017, E1): one 8 mm wide, 8 mm deep through-width groove under each declared cut plane (its x at the board top), board stays one body.

solver.rule: tlmpm_v5 law 8 for every digit count (packed codes; needed by cut_aware_surface_v1), max_cuts = goal_planner digits_used, slots_per_node 16 (WP-11 round 2: no overflow, max occupancy 8)

duration_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: probe compile, plan end = first DONE knot of the ideal reference schedule, duration = ceil((plan end + 1 s) / 0.5 s) * 0.5 s

dimension_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: lengths and widths to even millimetres, heights (and trim depths) to whole millimetres; raw draws and applied values are both recorded

common.cut_plane_rule: WP-11 Phase E rule: vertical, unyawed sever planes are snapped to solver node planes (multiples of grid_dx_m in the workpiece frame); tilted or yawed planes are not snapped

sever_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: minimum_part_mass_fraction = 0.5 x the smallest nominal piece fraction; every other sever threshold is the goals.py default

common.note: Copied verbatim from configs/wp12/benchmark_v1_DRAFT.json common (D5 re-declaration, 2026-10-31) so that this protocol does not change when the DRAFT does. Rows override only the listed nominal values.

row_rules.workpiece: common.nominal: bar 160 x 30 x 20 mm at the board centre, yaw 0, cutting_tasks_v1; dome p0 (rx 12, ry 10, h 8 mm) at x = 0.28 L = 44.8 mm for skims; trim_trim domes at +-50 mm (spread 0.3125 L)
row_rules.planes: vertical untilted planes on node planes (x = 0); tilted planes through local x = plane_x_at_board_top_m (0, a node line, as in E1) at z = 0, i.e. cut_fraction = (x0 + H/2 tan theta)/L (recorded as a derived draw); the slotted variant puts one 8 mm wide, 8 mm deep groove under the plane at the board top
row_rules.planner: common.planner (controller_profile path_v2, cut_extent plane_section) and the DEFAULT_OPTIONS of goal_planner (overtravel 4 mm, cut clearance 8 mm, cut 10 mm/s, skim 25 mm/s, rake 10 deg) unless a row value overrides one
row_rules.duration: common.duration_rule (plan end + 1 s, rounded up to 0.5 s)

metrics.outcome: goal_eval_v2a verdict and per-step verdicts (integrity / outcome layers)
metrics.separation: mechanical_components of the final packed codes (cut_topology, actual stencil graph) and direct code-0 bridges per cut digit (cut_diagnostics.direct_bridges, the law8_validation bridge rule) from the wrapper snapshot
metrics.armed_end: per armed segment: height of the lowest edge point above the workpiece-local board top (z = 0) at the last armed control step (solver-local end pose of cut_diagnostics_v1); compared with the 1 mm clean-cut window [0, 0.375] mm (WP12_WORKCELL.md section 5); on the slotted board it is negative (groove)
metrics.reachability: staged_v2 motion preflight receipt (status and the worst slack of every check, incl. knife_handle_clearance)
metrics.reported_only: physical_quality (substrate retention, material loss, penetration: particles below the board top), stability, runtime, geometry quality (particle_surface_v1, basic)

verdict_rules.CONFIRMED: formal run (label E2_FORMAL, not partial), status COMPLETE, policy_done, solver valid (no slot overflow, finite state), goal_eval_v2a verdict PASS, and for kind sever / sequence_with_sever: mechanical_components >= expected_pieces and 0 direct code-0 bridges on the bridge_digits; and the motion preflight PASS
verdict_rules.PASS_KINEMATIC_PREFLIGHT_FAIL: every outcome check above passes but the motion preflight fails (ik_unreachable or collision_constrained): physically separable, not executable on this workcell
verdict_rules.FAIL: a formal complete run where any outcome check fails (kept; a KNOWN_FAILURE candidate)
verdict_rules.ERROR: crash or an output directory without result.json (kept, never rerun silently)
verdict_rules.NOT_RUN: not executed (budget cap, infeasible before execution, or only DEV/partial output)
verdict_rules.infeasible_rows: a row whose feasibility class is not valid_feasible is still run (kinematic outcome and reachability are separate questions) unless it is scene_geometrically_infeasible, a classification_error or NOT_EXECUTABLE_BOARD_COLLISION; such a run can at best be PASS_KINEMATIC_PREFLIGHT_FAIL. physically_unsupported by envelope v1 (e.g. an operation pattern v1 does not list) does not stop a row: E2 exists to measure such cells
verdict_rules.prediction_met: verdict equals prediction.verdict; None for NO_DIRECTIONAL_PREDICTION, NOT_RUN and ERROR
verdict_rules.armed_end_falsification: SOLID_p05: FAIL with a measured armed end in (0, 0.375] mm supports the decision D1 argument; CONFIRMED falsifies it (then flat-board <= 5 deg in the planner becomes a PARTIALLY_VALIDATED candidate, decided by the xhigh reviewer); SOLID_p02 is reported with its armed end either way
verdict_rules.envelope_v2: proposal only (configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v2_PROPOSED.json; the xhigh reviewer decides): CONFIRMED moves the tested point of its cell to VALIDATED (kinematic, planner path_v2, this workpiece); FAIL makes it a KNOWN_FAILURE; PASS_KINEMATIC_PREFLIGHT_FAIL makes it KINEMATICALLY_UNREACHABLE on this workcell; NOT_RUN / ERROR leave v1 unchanged. No bound is widened beyond v1. A range enters the Phase 5 ID only if both of its tested ends are CONFIRMED (e.g. cut speed 8-12 mm/s needs CUT_v08 and CUT_v12; plane yaw +-15 needs YAW_p15 and YAW_m15)
verdict_rules.NOT_EXECUTABLE_BOARD_COLLISION: the formal motion preflight fails with a negative slack against a board body (tool_blade or tool_handle vs static_flat_board / board segments): the kinematic blade does not see the rigid board (WP12_WORKCELL.md section 5), so an episode would cut with the blade inside the board. The row is not executed; its cell is KINEMATICALLY_INFEASIBLE on this workcell with this planner
verdict_rules.zero_direct_bridges: checked on the row bridge_digits only (the sever digit); trim digits are judged by goal_eval_v2a (WP-11 trim criterion), their bridges are reported

budget.rule: GPU hours = summed wall time of E2 jobs (GPUs shared with the V1-V4 verification queue and other users; nvidia-smi checked before each launch; a lane with < 4000 MiB free waits; other processes are never touched). No row starts when finished + running + its estimate would exceed the cap; rows not started are NOT_RUN (budget). Rows run in the declared order (the decision-critical rows first).
budget.estimates: estimate_gpu_s = 42 wall-s per simulated s x the compiled episode duration + 30 s, from the DEV control row (0.832 s wall per 20 ms control step on a GPU shared at 100 % utilization). ADV rows are 0 (not executed: board collision).
budget.order_and_cap: Estimated total 2.24 GPU-h at the measured shared-GPU throughput. The orchestrator raised the cap from 2.0 to 3.0 GPU-h before the commit and before any formal row ran (no result seen), so all 18 runnable rows fit. Rows run in the declared priority order (Demo 2 slotted rows, the D1 falsification rows, the Demo 6 candidate and the mixed-operation rows, plane yaw, the speed rows, then rho 35 and psi +-10). Rows that the cap stops are NOT_RUN (budget); the cap is never raised after a result is seen.

outputs.runs: artifacts/wp12/phase4_e2_001/<row>/ (manifest.json, result.json, actions.jsonl, physics_state.npz, reliability.json, wp12_phase4a_diag.npz/json), queue.jsonl; logs artifacts/wp12/logs/phase4_e2_001_<row>.log (GNU time)

not_in_scope: any law, law parameter, threshold or controller change
Native or Lab runs (Demos 2 and 6 run in Native only after their E2 rows, separately)
more than one seed, workpiece or resolution per cell
the opt-in armed_end controller option (deferred, D4)
